tasks.gr10-life-roles-t3: Topic: Life Roles and Their Responsibilities. Cover life roles (child, student, adult, partner, mother, father, grandparent, breadwinner, employee, employer, leader, follower), the evolving nature and responsibilities of each role, how roles change and affect relationships, handling roles that clash by communicating, setting priorities and asking for help, and the influence of society and culture, including gender stereotypes, on roles. Ask Grade 10 learners to identify a role and its responsibility, explain how a new role changes responsibilities and relationships, handle a clash between two roles, or respond respectfully to an unfair expectation.
tasks.gr10-adolescence-adulthood-t3: Topic: From Adolescence to Adulthood. Cover the physical changes of adolescence (hormones, faster growth, body proportions, secondary sex characteristics, primary changes such as menstruation, ovulation and sperm production, skin problems), emotional changes (maturing personality, deeper emotions, insecurity, changing interests, beliefs and values, sexual interest), social changes (family relationships, peer groups, the need for acceptance, more responsibility) and coping with change through communication and friendships. Ask Grade 10 learners to classify a change as physical, emotional or social, explain that people develop at different ages, or choose a healthy way of coping. Keep every item age-appropriate, factual and free of graphic detail.
tasks.gr10-responsible-decisions-t3: Topic: Responsible Decisions about Sexuality and Lifestyle. Cover behaviour that can lead to teenage pregnancy, sexual abuse and rape (peer pressure, alcohol and drugs, unsafe places, online strangers, gifts from older people), the consequences (pregnancy, STIs including HIV, harm), protective values (respect for self and others, abstinence, self-control, privacy, the right to say no, responsibility), consent as a free and clear yes, skills (assertiveness, refusal, negotiation, decision-making, goal-setting, finding information), the law (the age of consent for sex in South Africa is 16, sex without consent is rape at any age, a child of 12 or older can ask a clinic for an HIV test or contraceptives under the Children's Act), where to find help (a trusted adult, a school counsellor, a clinic nurse, a social worker, the police, Childline on 116) and how recreation supports emotional health. Ask Grade 10 learners to identify risk, say whether consent was given, choose an assertive response, or choose where to find help. Keep every item age-appropriate, factual, respectful and free of graphic detail, and never blame a person who was abused.
tasks.gr10-diversity-of-jobs-t3: Topic: Diversity of Jobs and Career Fields. Cover the primary, secondary and tertiary economic sectors, work settings (indoors and outdoors, workplace conditions), activities in jobs (designing, assembling, growing), skills (gathering and analysing information, instructing), careers in the recreation, fitness and sport industries, researching a career (skills, salary package, promotion, further study) and transferable skills. Ask Grade 10 learners to place a job in its sector, match a job to its setting and activity, choose what to research about a career, or identify a transferable skill.
tasks.gr10-physical-education-t3: Topic: Physical Education: Recreation and Relaxation. Cover the difference between recreation and relaxation, relaxation techniques (slow deep breathing, gentle stretching, progressive muscle relaxation, picturing a calm place), choosing a recreation activity by cost, safety, time and interest, and safety in outdoor recreation (telling an adult, going with a group, sun and water, staying on paths, swimming only with supervision, caring for the environment). Ask Grade 10 learners to classify an activity, work out the time of a breathing exercise, choose a suitable activity for a situation, or choose the safe action.
